description: PAID, per call: search Transport Canada's Vehicle Recalls Database, full monthly file, by make, model, model year, recall number and keyword (give a make, a recall number or a keyword). Returns up to 10 recall rows, each with the dates of the data. The database leaves out inconsequential recalls. Remedy text and VINs are not included. You are not charged when nothing matches or when the data is out of date.

keyword.description: Words to find in the make, model, system and defect text. Every word must appear.

make.description: The vehicle make as Transport Canada publishes it, for example FORD.

model.description: The model name or a word of it, for example F-150.

recall_number.description: A Transport Canada or manufacturer recall number exactly as published.

name: search_vehicle_recalls_canada
